_comment: Patch 002 content — the 8 CCoP-1.2.1 defined terms, atomized. 6 are verbatim from the CCoP-1.2.1 table; 'CII' is resolved from Act s.2 read with s.7(1) (the table only said 'As defined in section 2 of the Act'); 'CIIO' is enriched with the Act s.2 'owner' definition. Each becomes a :Clause:Premise child of CCoP-1.2.1 with premise_kind='definition'.

terms.text: 'business continuity plan' ('BCP') means documented procedures that guide organisations to respond, recover, resume and restore businesses to a pre-defined level of operation following disruption and cover the resources, services and activities required to ensure the continuity of essential services.

'Commissioner' means the Commissioner of Cybersecurity appointed under section 4(1)(a) of the Act, and includes the Deputy Commissioner and Assistant Commissioners of Cybersecurity appointed under section 4(1)(b) of the Act.

'critical information infrastructure' ('CII') means a computer or a computer system in respect of which a designation under section 7(1) of the Cybersecurity Act 2018 is in effect. Under section 7(1), the Commissioner may designate a computer or computer system as a CII if satisfied that (a) the computer or computer system is necessary for the continuous delivery of an essential service and the loss or compromise of it will have a debilitating effect on the availability of the essential service in Singapore; and (b) the computer or computer system is located wholly or partly in Singapore.
terms.provenance: CCoP s.1.2.1 ('As defined in section 2 of the Act') RESOLVED from Cybersecurity Act 2018 s.2 read with s.7(1)

terms.text: 'CII asset' means the components of an IT or OT system and/or network infrastructure of a CII and includes physical devices and systems, software platforms and applications of the CII.
'CII Designation Date' means the date on which a computer or computer system was designated as a CII under section 7(1) of the Act.

'CIIO' means the owner of a CII. Under section 2 of the Cybersecurity Act 2018, 'owner', in relation to a CII, means the legal owner of the CII and, where the CII is jointly owned by more than one person, includes every joint owner.
terms.provenance: CCoP s.1.2.1 ENRICHED with Cybersecurity Act 2018 s.2 'owner'

terms.text: 'Code' means this Cybersecurity Code of Practice for Critical Information Infrastructure.
